events.speaker: narrator
events.text: An Echo can enter a room carrying a familiar face and voice.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Recognition may arrive before anyone settles the meaning of that resemblance.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Families, doctors, and administrators approach the same encounter with different needs.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Legal categories add another layer when a person depends on executable systems.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The story keeps their disagreements alive instead of resolving them through terminology.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Custody coordinates a society accustomed to receiving carefully managed outcomes.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Its authority often appears as convenience, reassurance, or competent protection.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: That makes an objection harder to frame than resistance to obvious cruelty.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: A diagnostic pause can carry consequences that legal language struggles to name.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The novel examines the distance between available rights and operational control.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Mara's experience gives that institutional question a particular human point of entry.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Control of interruption matters when the person speaking relies on someone else's infrastructure.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The story places partners, children, doctors, and copies around difficult choices.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Affection does not make their interests identical or their judgments interchangeable.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: Someone may want more time while another needs a boundary respected.

events.speaker: narrator
events.text: The book lets care become complicated without treating attachment as foolish.
